channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Te encontro em Sampa de onde agora se vê quem sobe ou desce a rampa
item.description: The text reflects on Brazilian cultural production in the early 1990s as an expression of post-dictatorship disillusionment, highlighting works like the film Terra estrangeira and songs by Jorge Ben Jor and Caetano Veloso that used the metaphor of the Planalto Palace ramp to criticize the disconnect between power and the people. It draws a parallel between the pessimism of that era and São Paulo’s ongoing role as a center of political protest, from demonstrations against Dilma Rousseff and Temer to the present, suggesting that while the symbolic distance between the ramp and the city has narrowed, the tension between power and society persists.

item.title: Nos EUA, Flávio Bolsonaro cita caso Master sem mencionar Dark Horse
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro cited the Banco Master investigation during a USTR hearing to link financial fraud to the Lula government, but omitted that he had sought funding from the bank's owner for the 'Dark Horse' biopic. He also defended Pix as beneficial to U.S. companies and called the timing of potential U.S. tariffs 'the worst possible,' arguing it would reward those responsible for the alleged misconduct.

item.title: Senado inclui partidos no rol de controle contra lavagem de dinheiro
item.description: The Senate's Public Security Committee approved a bill to include political parties in the anti-money laundering control framework. The proposal requires parties to maintain transaction records, notify the Coaf of suspicious operations to the Financial Activities Control Council (Coaf), and implement internal control mechanisms, and face fines of up to R$20 million for non-compliance. The bill now moves to the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: Trevisan: Flávio culpar Lula por tarifas é 'fala enganosa' até para Trump
item.description: Professor Leonardo Trevisan states that blaming President Lula for the tariffs imposed by the U.S. on Brazil is a misleading claim, even under Donald Trump's logic. He argues the assertion does not hold up technically or politically, as U.S. tariffs are unilaterally decided by the American government.

item.title: Crusoé: Flávio vai para Washington enquanto Lula não tem pressa
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president, will participate this Tuesday, February 7, in a public hearing at the U.S. Trade Representative’s Office (USTR), accompanied by his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro. While Flávio travels to Washington, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva shows no urgency in responding or taking a stance on the matter. The Bolsonaro brothers’ move suggests an international projection strategy aimed at strengthening their electoral base ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Zema culpa Lula por tarifaço e diz esperar solução 'independentemente de quem vier'
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) blamed the foreign policy of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's government for the U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products, but said he expects a solution regardless of who resolves the issue.

item.title: Moraes autoriza PF a ouvir Flávio Bolsonaro por acusação de calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized the Federal Police to hear Senator Flávio Bolsonaro over alleged slander against President Lula, based on a January social media post linking Lula to Nicolás Maduro and accusing him of drug trafficking, money laundering, and election fraud. The hearing must occur within 10 days following a PGR request, which noted the potential for Bolsonaro to retract his statements and avoid punishment. Both are pre-candidates in the 2026 presidential election.

item.title: Como El Niño pode mexer com a eleição presidencial no Brasil
item.description: The El Niño phenomenon, expected to intensify in 2026, could significantly impact Brazil’s presidential elections by worsening droughts, raising food prices, and increasing wildfire risks in the Amazon. Although the government has issued alerts and prepared preventive measures, experts warn that bank financing for deforestation-linked commodity chains — totaling $429 billion between 2016 and 2025 — could undermine these efforts, making forests more flammable. Environmental and social movements from Brazil, Malaysia, and Indonesia are urging banks to halt funding for destructive activities and redirect credit toward sustainable practices like agroecology and agroforestry.

item.title: Eduardo posta foto com Flávio, mas é cortado pela pré-campanha
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro posted a photo alongside his brother, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, during a U.S. hearing on American tariffs of 25% on Brazilian goods. Flávio’s pre-campaign profile reposted the image, preserving the original photo showing both brothers together.

item.title: Lula tem 24% de eleitores à direita, e Flávio Bolsonaro, 19% à esquerda, indica Datafolha
item.description: A new Datafolha poll shows 24% of Lula’s voters identify with the right or center-right, while 19% of Flávio Bolsonaro’s supporters align with the left or center-left, indicating significant ideological crossover. The right and center-right have regained majority status in Brazil’s electorate (44% vs 39%), reversing their 2022 minority position. Shifts are driven by attitudes on crime, religion, homosexuality, and poverty, with notable contradictions: 34% of Flávio’s voters support banning guns, and 61% of Lula’s and 81% of Flávio’s voters favor trying teenagers as adults for offenses.

item.title: O discurso de Flávio Bolsonaro para adiar tarifaço e blindar a própria campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's pre-candidate for President, urged the United States to delay the Trump administration's proposed tariffs on Brazilian goods, arguing that imposing them now would unfairly benefit President Lula in the October elections. Accompanied by Eduardo Bolsonaro, he stated that Brazil's political landscape will change completely in 90 days and that penalizing the country at this moment would be unjust and counterproductive.

item.title: Juiz diz que domiciliar pode "interferir" em benefícios de Bolsonaro
item.description: Federal Judge Pedro Pereira Pimenta of Belo Horizonte’s 8th Federal Civil Court ruled that the extension of Jair Bolsonaro’s house arrest may influence the evaluation of his entitlement to former presidential benefits, including official vehicles, security, drivers, and staff. The judge requested the inclusion of STF rulings on Bolsonaro’s humanitarian house arrest and ordered the MPF, Bolsonaro’s defense, and the petitioning councilman to submit statements within five days, after which the case will proceed to sentencing. The lawsuit, filed by PT councilman Pedro Rousseff, challenges whether Bolsonaro, while incarcerated, should retain these privileges.

item.title: ‘Dark Horse’: Defesa de Flávio Bolsonaro recorre para que Mendonça assuma relatoria de caso de emendas no lugar de Dino
item.description: The defense of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro is requesting that Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça take over as rapporteur in the case concerning the alleged use of parliamentary amendments to fund the film 'Dark Horse', currently under investigation. They argue Dino, citing potential bias due to Dino's perceived political and argue Mendonça, appointed by Jair Bolsonaro, is more impartial, especially since he already oversees a related probe involving Flávio Bolsonaro and financier Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Moraes dá 10 dias para PF tomar depoimento de Flávio em ação sobre Lula
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has ordered the Federal Police to hear Senator Flávio Bolsonaro within ten days in an investigation into alleged slander against President Lula. The case stems from remarks Flávio made in January following the capture of Venezuelan dictator Nicolás Maduro. The inquiry examines whether Flávio committed defamation against the president.

item.title: Em audiência nos EUA, Flávio acusa Lula e defende cancelamento de tarifaço
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a pre-candidate for the Brazilian presidency, defended during a hearing at the U.S. Trade Representative's Office (USTR) in Washington the cancellation of tariffs imposed on Brazilian products, accusing the Lula government of harming the country’s foreign trade. He urged U.S. authorities to reassess the trade measures, arguing they negatively impact Brazil’s economy and domestic producers.

item.title: Os cálculos do PL para o palanque no Rio após operação da PF contra candidato ao Senado
item.description: The Federal Police's Operation Unha e Carne is creating uncertainty for the PL's Senate slate in Rio de Janeiro, following searches targeting former Belford Roxo mayor Márcio Canella (União) and the withdrawal of ex-governor Cláudio Castro. The party is awaiting further developments to determine if candidates remain viable, with particular concern over Rogéria Bolsonaro's presence as a substitute. Potential replacements would be sought within União Brasil or, if needed, the PP, due to the federative alliance.

item.title: Em evento com mulheres, Zema associa presença feminina na política a combate à corrupção e cita caso Master: ‘Não vi mulher envolvida’
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pre-candidate for President, advocated for greater female participation in politics as a means to combat corruption, citing the Banco Master case as an example where, he claimed, only men were involved. He stated that women commit fewer crimes, referencing low female incarceration rates, and linked female political presence to long-term vision and greater nobility. Zema also reaffirmed his support for policies addressing domestic violence against women.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 24% de eleitores à direita, e Flávio Bolsonaro, 19% à esquerda
item.description: A Datafolha survey reveals that 24% of voters who declared support for Lula are ideologically classified as right-wing, while 19% of Flávio Bolsonaro’s supporters are positioned as left-wing. This indicates a significant misalignment between self-declared voting intentions and perceived ideological positioning. The finding reflects the complexity of Brazilian polarization and the fluidity of political identities in 2026.

item.title: Gilmar exalta Neymar e Ancelotti em mensagem sobre eliminação
item.description: Gilmar Mendes, a justice of the Brazilian Supreme Federal Court, praised Neymar and Carlo Ancelotti in a public message following Brazil's elimination from the 2026 World Cup, thanking them for their dedication and discipline throughout the cycle. He emphasized that building a World Cup campaign requires years of collective effort and responsibility from everyone involved.

item.title: Eduardo critica ausência do governo Lula em audiência nos EUA
item.description: Former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro criticized President Lula for not sending official representatives to the USTR hearing in Washington on potential tariffs on Brazilian goods, claiming the government wants the tariffs. Only embassy observers were present, while Senator Flávio Bolsonaro actively participated alongside Roberto Azevêdo, advocating against the tariffs on behalf of Brazilian industry. The USTR must make a final decision by July 15.

item.title: O fator decisivo para o sucesso de governos de direita na América do Sul, segundo estudo
item.description: A study by Ranking dos Políticos reveals that despite electoral victories by the right in South America, government success depends more on the ability to build stable legislative majorities than on winning elections. Congressional fragmentation necessitates constant coalition-building to pass reforms, as seen in Peru with Keiko Fujimori and in Ecuador with Daniel Noboa. Brazil, with its highly fragmented party system, faces similar challenges, making governability nearly impossible without broad alliances in the National Congress.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: Quem vai acabar com o tarifaço? Lula ou Flávio?
item.description: The Meio-Dia em Brasília program discusses the dispute between the Lula government and pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro to reverse the up to 25% tariff imposed by the U.S. on Brazilian products. The debate involves Itamaraty and political strategy to mitigate the economic impacts of Trump’s measure. The content also addresses other unspecified exclusions.

item.title: Flávio diz que ficará mais tempo nos EUA para reverter tarifas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro canceled his agenda in Pernambuco to stay an extra day in the United States, attending a USTR hearing aimed at reversing tariffs imposed by Donald Trump. He described the U.S. tariff policy as 'very bad' for both Brazil and the United States.

item.title: Defesa de Flávio Bolsonaro aciona Fachin para tirar Dino de caso 'Dark Horse'
item.description: The defense of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro has appealed to STF President Minister Edson Fachin to remove the investigation into alleged irregular transfers of amendments to entities linked to the film 'Dark Horse' from the rapporteurship of Minister Flávio Dino and assign it to Minister André Mendonça.

item.title: 'Ainda não votei em você, mas quem sabe um dia', diz Arthur Lira a Renan Filho durante agenda em Alagoas
item.description: During an electoral event in Limoeiro de Anadia, Arthur Lira (PP-AL) joked with Renan Filho (MDB-AL) that he has not yet voted for him, but perhaps one day he will. The meeting took place at the launch of the pré-candidacies of Antônio Albuquerque (União) and Nivaldo Albuquerque (Republicanos), with other leaders such as Paulo Dantas and Davi Davino Filho also present. Lira also criticized the recent performance of Alagoas senators, stating that democracy sometimes errs in choosing representatives.

item.title: Temer diz que Dilma “nunca mais” falou com ele após impeachment
item.description: Michel Temer stated that Dilma Rousseff never spoke to him again after the 2016 impeachment, following a disagreement over his comment that she was 'honest' regarding the Pasadena refinery purchase. He described the January 8, 2023 attacks as a clear attempt at a coup d'état, praised the STF, and affirmed that while the merits of the Court's decisions can be questioned, its constitutional powers cannot be challenged.

item.title: Gayer pede explicações sobre exclusão de conteúdo de Lula da Agência Brasil
item.description: Federal Deputy Gustavo Gayer (PL-GO) requested explanations from Empresa Brasil de Comunicação regarding the removal of journalistic content involving President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva during the electoral period. He asked the Presidency’s Secretariat of Social Communication to detail the technical and legal grounds for excluding the material from Agência Brasil. The request was filed in the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: Flávio tenta reverter desgaste na campanha e diz nos EUA que tarifaço de Trump é ruim para o Brasil e os americanos
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) sought to mitigate political backlash from his involvement in the U.S.-Brazil trade dispute by stating in Washington that Trump’s proposed tariffs are harmful to both Brazil and the United States. He announced he would extend his stay in the U.S. to attend additional meetings, canceling his Pernambuco agenda, and argued that tariffs should be avoided through technical and political negotiation. While opposing the tariffs, Flávio blamed Lula for the trade crisis, claiming he is 'protecting Brazil from tariffs and Lula,' and predicted that starting next year, Brazil will have a president capable of negotiating with the U.S. as an equal.

item.title: Ex-prefeito alvo da PF anunciou mãe de Flávio Bolsonaro como suplente ao Senado
item.description: Marcello Canella, former mayor of Belford Roxo and Senate pre-candidate for União Brasil, announced Rogéria Bolsonaro, mother of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), as his first alternate on the Senate ticket in a February 2026 agreement. Canella is a target of the 6th phase of Operation Unha e Carne, which investiges an alleged money laundering scheme involving R$7.6 billion through a network of gas stations. The alliance between Canella and the Bolsonaro clan, solidified after his break with Mayor Waguinho, has raised concerns in Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign due to the negative reputational impact of the investigation.

item.title: Defesa de Flávio Bolsonaro aciona Fachin para tirar Dino de caso ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: The defense of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro asked Supreme Court President Edson Fachin to transfer the investigation into alleged irregular parliamentary amendments for the film 'Dark Horse' from Justice Flávio Dino to André Mendonça, arguing that Mendonça already oversees related probes into Banco Master and the film's financing to avoid conflicting rulings.

item.title: Flávio pede a Fachin que tire de Dino relatoria sobre caso Dark Horse
item.description: The defense of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro asked STF President Edson Fachin to remove Minister Flávio Dino as rapporteur in the investigation into alleged parliamentary amendment transfers to the producer of the film Dark Horse, requesting redistribution to Minister André Mendonça. The argument is that Dino already oversees multiple similar cases, and Mendonça, who is rapporteur of a related investigation into Banco Master’s funding of the same film, would be more appropriate to avoid concentration of duties. The petition relies on a prior submission by deputies alleging an 'interconnected legal entities ecosystem' tied to the film’s production.

item.title: As 'vices' de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro’s preferred running mate is Daniella Marques, according to close associates. However, allies indicate that Senator Tereza Cristina is also being considered in behind-the-scenes talks. The report is exclusive to subscribers, requiring registration for full access.

item.title: Indicado por Flávio ao Senado é alvo da Polícia Federal
item.description: Márcio Canella, former mayor of Belford Roxo and pre-candidate for the Senate from União Brasil, is one of the targets of the sixth phase of Operation Unha e Carne, launched by the Federal Police. The PF is investigating an alleged money laundering scheme involving a network of gas stations in the region. The operation examines possible links between the politician and financial criminal activities.

item.title: Áudio: Vítimas de trabalho análogo à escravidão têm proteção ampliada por lei
item.description: President Lula signed Law 15.455/2026, which expands protections for domestic workers rescued from conditions analogous to slavery, prioritizing their access to Bolsa Família and guaranteeing six unemployment insurance installments at minimum wage value. The law was approved by the Senate in June and signed with a presidential veto.

item.title: Indústria brasileira de calçados contará com apoio de associações dos EUA em audiência sobre tarifas nesta terça-feira
item.description: Three U.S. associations will testify in favor of Brazilian footwear in a USTR hearing on tariffs, according to Abicalçados. The hearing takes place this Tuesday on the same panel where Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL’s pre-candidate for president, will also participate. The sector aims to overturn the threatened 25% tariff on Brazilian goods by the Trump administration.

item.title: CE: líder do PL diz que Priscila Costa perdeu 'momento prudente' em crise com Michelle e Flávio
item.description: The PL leader in the Ceará Legislative Assembly, Silvana Oliveira, criticized councilwoman Priscila Costa for delaying her response to the crisis involving Michelle and Flávio Bolsonaro, saying she missed the 'prudent moment'. The remarks were made to newspaper O Povo.

item.title: Ex-secretário de Polícia Civil e pré-candidato ao Senado são alvos de operação da PF; veja quem são
item.description: The Federal Police launched the sixth phase of Operation Unha e Carne, executing 19 search and seizure warrants in Rio de Janeiro against a suspected criminal organization that allegedly used gas stations to launder money. Among the targets are Marcus Amim, former Civil Police Secretary of Rio, and Márcio Canella, a Senate pre-candidate for União Brasil and former mayor of Belford Roxo, both suspected of money laundering, criminal organization, and illegal direct contracting. The investigation alleges over R$ 7.6 billion moved in six years and is part of the Mission Redentor II task force.

item.title: Guerra entre Flávio e Michelle deixa candidatura de principal liderança feminina do Ceará em xeque
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro's resignation as head of PL Women has caused ripple effects in Ceará, undermining the political prospects of councilwoman Priscila Costa, who was previously considered a potential running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro or Senate candidate. Although she could still run for federal deputy, Priscila has expressed preference to remain in the municipal chamber due to party disarray and the PL's support for Ciro Gomes. The selection of Alcides Fernandes for the Senate further marginalized Priscila in the state electoral landscape.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro participa de audiência nos EUA sobre tarifas nesta terça
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro attended a USTR public hearing in Washington to discuss proposed U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods and defend the PIX payment system. He seeks a 180-day delay in tariff implementation, arguing they would politically benefit the Lula government, and submitted a document stating PIX should not be integrated with non-Western international settlement platforms. His actions are independent of the Brazilian Foreign Ministry and occur as he positions himself as a 2026 presidential pre-candidate.

item.title: Lindbergh chama Flávio e Eduardo Bolsonaro de “traidores da pátria”
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) accused Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro of being 'traitors of the homeland' for their actions regarding U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products, claiming the Bolsonaro family is responsible for the measure and acting to benefit Jair Bolsonaro. He stated that the Brazilian people’s response will come at the polls in October 2026.

item.title: Comissão debate a pauta da infância e da adolescência nas eleições de 2026; participe
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Human Rights, Minorities and Racial Equality Committee will hold a public hearing on childhood and adolescence in the 2026 elections, proposed by Deputy Erika Kokay (PT-DF). The debate aims to increase visibility of children's and adolescents' rights in electoral platforms and foster dialogue among Legislative, Executive, civil society, and experts, including the presentation of proposals from the Agenda 227 coalition.

item.title: Temer reconhece problemas causados por decreto das bets, assinado por ele em 2018: ‘Não aplaudo meu ato’
item.description: Former Brazilian president Michel Temer acknowledged that the 2018 decree legalizing sports betting caused social harms, stating 'I do not applaud my own act'. He noted regulation only came in 2023 under Lula, after Bolsonaro’s administration ignored the issue, and cited rising debt and online gambling addiction as negative consequences.

item.title: Operação da PF que mirou candidato ao Senado pelo União Brasil atinge Rueda indiretamente
item.description: The Federal Police operation targeting former Belford Roxo mayor Márcio Canella indirectly affected Antonio Rueda, national president of União Brasil. The action is part of investigations into alleged irregularities in municipal contracts, with Rueda not being a direct target. The subscriber-only article highlights indirect political links in the context of the 2026 elections.

item.title: PF faz buscas contra Márcio Canella e Marcus Amim no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: The Federal Police conducted searches against former Belford Roxo mayor and Senate pre-candidate Márcio Canella, president of União Brasil in Rio de Janeiro, and former Civil Police Secretary Marcus Amim, in the sixth phase of Operation Unha e Carne. The action investigates an alleged money laundering scheme involving gas stations, with movements exceeding R$ 7.6 billion over the last six years. Warrants were also executed in Niterói, São Gonçalo, Itaboraí, and Resende, including asset seizures and suspension of economic activities of companies linked to the suspects.

item.title: Zema pede novo julgamento de Bolsonaro
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's pre-candidate for president, advocated for a new trial of Jair Bolsonaro over the attempted coup, stating the process had 'more political than judicial conduct'. He likened Bolsonaro's situation to amnesty granted to opponents of the military dictatorship, while acknowledging that amnesty would have a 'very large' institutional impact. Zema also questioned the STF's competence to judge the former president.

item.title: Por que saneamento é um tema sempre negligenciado nas eleições?
item.description: Basic sanitation is often neglected in Brazilian elections due to campaign teams' lack of technical expertise and the tendency to make vague promises without clear targets. Despite its importance for health, economy, and quality of life, the issue remains peripheral in political debates, while millions of Brazilians still lack access to treated water and sewage collection. The #VotoNoSaneamento campaign by Instituto Trata Brasil aims to raise awareness among voters and candidates to prioritize sanitation as a political priority and governance legacy.

item.title: Ex-chefe da Polícia Civil do RJ e ex-prefeito de Belford Roxo são alvo da PF por lavagem de R$7,6 bi
item.description: The Federal Police launched the sixth phase of Operation Unha e Carne, investigating an alleged money laundering scheme of R$7.6 billion involving a network of gas stations in Rio de Janeiro's metropolitan area. Key targets include former Rio Civil Police Secretary Marcus Amim and former Belford Roxo mayor and Senate pre-candidate Márcio Canella (União Brasil). The operation involves 19 search warrants, asset seizures, and suspension of economic activities of companies linked to the suspects.

item.title: Alvaro Dias lidera disputa ao Senado no Paraná, diz pesquisa
item.description: Alvaro Dias (MDB) leads the Senate race in Paraná, according to a Paraná Pesquisas poll released on July 7, 2026. Gleisi Hoffmann (PT), Deltan Dallagnol (Novo), Alexandre Curi (Republicanos) and Filipe Barros (PL) are in a technical tie for the second seat, with a margin of error of 2.6 percentage points. The survey, funded by the Liberal Party and registered with the TSE under PR-01166/2026, interviewed 1,500 people in Paraná between July 3 and 6, 2026, with a 95% confidence level.

item.title: O que está em jogo em audiência de investigação dos EUA contra o Brasil em que Flávio Bolsonaro vai falar
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, a senator and pre-candidate for president, will participate in the final day of U.S. public hearings on alleged unfair trade practices by Brazil, advocating against 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, especially to protect the Pix payment system. He claims the tariffs would constitute a 'political victory' for Lula’s government and urges a delay until after Brazil’s October elections. The investigation, launched in July 2023, includes private sector representatives from both nations, with a final decision expected by July 15.

item.title: A desconfortável escolha entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The text reflects extreme polarization in opinions about Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro among the author's acquaintances, illustrating visceral rejection on both sides: some would give Lula the middle finger, while others would send Flávio Bolsonaro to the U.S. on a one-way ticket. The choice between them is described as uncomfortable due to the depth of mutual aversion.
